subject: food-technology
title: Scales of Food Production
welcome_lead: From craft bakery to continuous breakfast cereal line.
meta_desc: A-Level Food Tech: bespoke, batch, mass and continuous production.

concepts.def: Defined quantity of identical units in a single run.
Continuous flow line producing standard product.
Time required to change a line for a new product.

walkthroughs.body_html: One-off (wedding cake), batch (microbrewery, 1,000 loaves), mass (Mr Kipling cake plant), continuous (milk pasteurisation, breakfast cereal extruder running 24/7).
Larger scales reduce per-unit cost via economies of scale but require expensive plant and reliable supply. Continuous production rewards predictable demand; batch suits variety.
The UK food and drink manufacturing sector employs ~430,000 people and contributes ~£35 billion GVA per year (FDF figures). Top firms: Greencore, Bakkavor, Müller, 2 Sisters.
